assets.what: A round boss, 30x30 units: three trumpet-spirals about a centre at 120 degrees, inside a plain ring. Celtic, by descent -- 'Ultimate La Tene' spiral work, and the one element in the Insular vocabulary whose ancestry nobody disputes. A metalwork BOSS is a raised dome; on a flat page it becomes a roundel, because Insular illumination has no relief tradition to imitate.

assets.what: A spray, 60x22 units, trailing off an initial toward the text. DIMINUENDO -- the Insular device by which a giant opening initial steps DOWN through letters of decreasing size until it merges with the running hand. assets.what: A zoomorphic terminal, 44x22 units: a ribbon running in from the left and ending in a beast's head that grips it. GERMANIC, by descent -- Salin's Style II, the Migration-period animal art of Sutton Hoo, Taplow and the Staffordshire Hoard: ribbon-bodied, snake-headed, deliberately non-naturalistic, gripping with its jaws to resolve a strand-end. The popular account has this backwards and the archive should not repeat it: THE SPIRALS ARE CELTIC AND THE BEASTS ARE GERMANIC.

assets.what: The light initial, 34x34 units: a field of red-lead dots outlining an empty letter slot, and nothing else. The most authentic of the three. EADFRITH'S DOT-OUTLINING, the Lindisfarne signature -- letterforms surrounded by a stipple of red lead (minium). 10,600 dots are counted on the Luke incipit alone, f.139r; replication at about thirty dots a minute puts that one page's stippling at six hours of continuous work. Modern conservation microscopy finds craquelure in the dots themselves, so they were raised mounds of pigment rather than flat specks.

That reading said 'tolkiengateway.net returns HTTP 403 to this archive', and it was true then. CORRECTED 7 September 2026 under C363, beneath the original rather than over it: the host returns 200 to the honest UA ArdaArchiveResearch/1.0 over curl -4. A recorded refusal that has expired is worse than no record -- anything reading it concludes the host is unreachable and stops trying, which is how a wall nobody re-measures becomes permanent.
assets.what: A passage of continuous sarati in vertical columns, the Two Trees. Its reading, supplied by the archive's owner: Valar empannen Aldaru / mi kon-alkorin / ar sealalan taro / ar silankalan ve laure ve misil — the Gods planted the Two Trees in a blessed garth, and they grow high and shine like gold like silver. The forms are attested early Qenya; their weight sits in Vinyar Tengwar 27, which this archive holds only as a machine reading, so the text is attested and uncitable at once.
